text.text: Marty was fantastic—honest, knowledgeable, professional, and very reasonable with pricing. Another bigger company told me I needed a full system replacement for $14,000 or repairs ranging from $2,500 (best case) to $4,700 (worst case), with no cheaper options. Marty came out, carefully checked everything, and recommended using a leak sealant instead—exactly what I was hoping for. The total cost was less than a third of the $2,500 estimate from the 1st bigger company, and the AC is working great now. On top of that, he charged $100 less per pound for Freon compared to the first company. I highly recommend Marty if you want honest advice and quality service without the upsell!
